```{r setup, include = F}
# analysis
library(clusterProfiler)

# plotting
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(pheatmap)
library(cowplot)

# databases
library(msigdbr)

# tidyverse
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r load helpers}
source("../R/helpers.R")
```

```{r load data}
source("../R/main-data.R")
```

3431 genes that are regulated by IL1B at any time.

```{r genes of interest}
# identify genes
goi = tc_dea %>%
  filter(treatment == "IL1B" & sig != "ns") %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()
```

3394 genes that are regulated by IL1B at their peak

```{r genes of interest}
# identify genes
goi2 = tc_dea %>%
  filter(treatment == "IL1B" & peak_sig != "ns") %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()
```

Number of genes that are up- or down-regulated.

```{r fig 1a, fig.height=2.5, fig.width=2}
df = tc_dea %>%
  filter(treatment == "IL1B" & sig != "ns") %>%
  select(Gene, sig) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  count(sig)

ggplot(df, aes(x = sig, y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -1) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 2.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2)))

cleanup_objects()
```

Number of genes that are up- or down-regulated at each peak

```{r fig 1b, fig.height=2.5, fig.width=3}
df = tc_dea %>%
  filter(treatment == "IL1B" & peak_sig != "ns") %>%
  select(Gene, peak_sig, peak) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  count(peak_sig, peak)

ggplot(df, aes(x = peak, y = n)) +
  facet_wrap(~peak_sig) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -1) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2)))

cleanup_objects()
```



```{r fig 1c, fig.height=2.5, fig.width=3}

# related to il1b-bud-timecourse/modules/pca.R

# prep matrix
mat = tc_tpm %>%
  filter(
    Gene %in% goi,
    treatment %in% c("NS", "IL1B")
  ) %>%
  mutate(sample = paste(treatment, time, rep)) %>%
  select(Gene, sample, log2tpm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample", values_from = "log2tpm") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

# run pca
pca <- prcomp(t(mat), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

# convert pca output to df
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  separate(sample, into = c("treatment","time","rep"), sep = " ") %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("NS", "IL1B")),
    time = factor(time, levels = c(1, 2, 6, 12, 24))
  )

# compute replicate-level distances from NS
pca_distance <- pca_df %>%
  select(treatment, rep, time, PC1, PC2) %>%
  left_join(
    pca_df %>%
      filter(treatment == "NS") %>%
      select(rep, time, PC1, PC2) %>%
      rename(PC1_NS = PC1, PC2_NS = PC2),
    by = c("rep", "time")
  ) %>%
  filter(treatment != "NS") %>%
  mutate(
    dist = sqrt(
      (PC1 - PC1_NS)^2 + (PC2 - PC2_NS)^2
    )
  ) %>%
  select(treatment, time, rep, dist)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = time, shape = treatment)) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1
  ) +
  labs(color = NULL, shape = NULL)

ggplot(pca_distance, aes(x = time, y = dist)) +
  stat_summary(geom = "col", fun = "mean") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "white") +
  labs(y = "Euclidean distance from NS")


cleanup_objects()
```



```{r fig 1d, fig.height=4, fig.width=4, dpi=600}
#related to il1b-timecourse/modules/fig-il1b-heatmap.R

goi <- tc_dea %>%
  filter(peak_sig != "ns" & treatment == "IL1B") %>%
  pull(Gene) %>% unique() %>% sort()

mat <- tc_tpm %>%
  filter(Gene %in% goi & treatment == "IL1B") %>%
  mutate(sample = paste0("t", time, "h ", rep)) %>%
  select(Gene, sample, log2fold) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "sample", values_from = "log2fold") %>%
  select(
    Gene, 
    contains("t1h"), 
    contains("t2h"), 
    contains("t6h"), 
    contains("t12h"), 
    contains("t24h")
    ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

# %>% 
#   { .[hclust(dist(.), method = "ward.D2")$order, ] }

colors = circlize::colorRamp2(
  seq(-5, 5, length = 200),
  colorRampPalette(c("steelblue4", "steelblue3" , "white", "firebrick3", "firebrick4"))(200))

columnSplits <- factor(
  c(
    rep("1", 4), 
    rep("2", 4), 
    rep("6", 4), 
    rep("12", 4), 
    rep("24", 4)), 
  levels = c("1", "2", "6", "12", "24")
)

Heatmap(
  mat,
  col = colors,
  cluster_rows = T, cluster_columns = F,
  clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
  show_row_dend = T, show_column_dend = F,
  show_row_names = F, show_column_names = F,
  column_split = columnSplits,
  border = T,
  use_raster = T,
  name = "log2fold"
)
```


```{r fig 1e, dpi=1200}
# format hallmark for clusterProfiler
hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
  select("gs_name", "gene_symbol")

# get ranked list of genes at their peak
ranks = tc_dea %>%
  filter(treatment == "IL1B", sig != "ns", time == peak) %>%
  select(Gene, log2fold) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2fold)) %>%
  deframe()

# run gsea
gsea = GSEA(
  geneList = ranks,
  TERM2GENE = hallmark,
  pvalueCutoff = 1,
  verbose = F
)

gsea_df = gsea %>%
  as.tibble() %>%
  select(
    Description,
    NES,
    p.adjust
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Description = gsub("HALLMARK_", "", Description),
    Description = gsub("_", " ", Description)
    ) %>%
  arrange(NES) %>%
  mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = unique(Description)))
  
ggplot(
  gsea_df %>% filter(p.adjust <= 0.05),
  aes(x = NES, y = Description, fill = -log10(p.adjust))
) +
  geom_col() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    fill = expression(-log[10] * "(FDR)"),
    y = NULL
  )

barplot(ranks)
```
